integrity: Finite elementary unimodular operation certificates are complete for the stated cases, and a standalone verifier reconstructs and replays them; modular checks are ancillary, not substitutes for the integral certificates.
scientific_limitations: The exact Smith classifications are proved only for zero through three named parameters. No formula for four or more parameters, no assertion about finite induced-substructure adjacency, and no independent external certification is claimed. Historical priority remains provisional against unindexed product-grid integer-matrix literature.
title: The first odd Smith torsion in three-order incomparability feasibility
